title: Wild Bill Hickok
paragraphs: A family Western adventure series starring Guy Madison as Wild Bill Hickok with Andy Devine as his sidekick Jingles, combining frontier lawman stories with action and humor.
Juvenile/family Western adventure starring Guy Madison as Wild Bill Hickok and Andy Devine as Jingles P. Jones.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Original Mutual production run (April 1, 1951 to December 31, 1954) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and Syndication/rebroadcast phase (July 17, 1955 to February 12, 1956) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Andy Devine (performer), Guy Madison (performer), David Hire (producer and writer), Paul Pierce (director, writer, and producer), Charles Lyon (announcer and music), Richard Aurandt (music, performer, and composer), and Larry Hayes (writer and performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].
The stories often return to robbery and theft, outlaws and bandits, mining and prospecting, stagecoach and frontier transport, ranching and cattle, and frontier towns and settlements.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Postwar juvenile Western radio boom, Cereal sponsorship and youth premiums, and Parallel radio and television Western franchise.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]].
